profit_quality.assessment: 2024 profit converted strongly to cash, but the three-year record is volatile: 2022 core business loss and negative operating cash flow, 2023 core profit was small and free cash flow after capex was near zero, while 2024 benefited from new games, APP Business growth and lower R&D intensity.
adjustments: Use 2024 core business net profit HK$655.542m as pre-haircut distributable cash profit, rather than reported parent net profit HK$580.676m, because 2024 investment-related loss is non-core.
Treat Fuzhou self-use office construction capex as mostly one-off/growth; maintenance capex lower bound is estimated from servers, computers and software spending of about HK$14.8m.
Apply 0.55 profit haircut because 2022-2023 show weak or negative cash generation and the game portfolio is hit-driven and marketing-sensitive.
Operating lease liabilities are not deducted from cash because they are ordinary continuing-operation leases; their cash effect is already in cash flow and haircut.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: Operating cash flow was HK$-98.239m in 2022, HK$128.577m in 2023 and HK$1,120.857m in 2024; capex was about HK$134m each year, largely including Fuzhou office construction.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: One strong year is not enough to use near-1.0 cash profit factor; the business has high gross margin and low working capital, but game/APP revenue and promotion intensity are volatile.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: 2024 operating cash flow / parent net profit = 1.93x, but the prior two years prevent treating it as stable.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Maintenance capex estimated at HK$14.8m from servers, computers and software; total 2024 capex was HK$133.875m including Fuzhou self-use office construction.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2024 working capital helped operating cash flow through lower funds receivable and higher payables; this is not assumed to fully repeat.
